name: Google Photos Ambient
description: Show photos selected in Google Photos as a native Kiosk Satellite screensaver using the Google Photos Ambient API.
author: Stuart Pearson

settings.title: Google OAuth client ID
settings.description: Use a TVs and Limited Input devices OAuth client with the Ambient API enabled.

settings.title: Name in Google Photos
settings.description: Used when pairing a new device. Disconnect and pair again to change the registered name.

settings.title: Saved pairing request ID (managed by plugin)
Saved OAuth client binding (managed by plugin)

buttons.title: Connect Google Photos
buttons.label: Sign in
buttons.description: Displays a Google verification URL and code. Keep this page open while signing in and selecting photos.

confirm.title: Disconnect Google Photos?
confirm.message: Remove this Ambient device from Google Photos and erase its saved local connection?

buttons.title: Forget a broken connection
buttons.label: Forget locally
buttons.description: Recovery only, for revoked credentials or a lost OAuth client. Does not delete the device in Google Photos.

confirm.title: Forget locally without deleting the Google device?
confirm.message: Erase local credentials even if Google is unreachable? Remove the old device manually in Google Photos. A new pairing creates a new device.
